summary: Dependabot dependency bump: locked versions move pydantic 2.13.4->2.13.5, sqlmodel 0.0.39->0.0.47, alembic 1.19.1->1.20.0, plus dev tools (prek, ruff, ty, typer, zizmor, coverage). models.py drops the explicit DateTime(timezone=True) column type because new sqlmodel maps datetime to a timezone-aware UTCDateTime by default (same DB column type), and the pre-commit bump workflow uses the renamed 'prek update' command.

statements.why: No logins, money, secrets or data loss involved; the created_at change is equivalent (sqlmodel 0.0.46+ get_sqlalchemy_type returns UTCDateTime = DateTime(timezone=True)).

statements.text: 1. Test anything that uses pydantic: it was upgraded from >2.0 to >=2.13.5.
statements.why: Only the minimum constraint moved; the installed version was already 2.13.4 and goes to 2.13.5, a patch release. Testing is harmless but the wording suggests a big jump from 2.0.

statements.text: 2. Test anything that uses sqlmodel: it was upgraded from >=0.0.39 to >=0.0.46.
statements.why: Real bump (lock 0.0.39 -> 0.0.47) that changes how datetime columns are typed/validated (aware datetimes required on write); worth testing saves of users/items.

misses.what: alembic (database migrations tool) is also bumped 1.19.1 -> 1.20.0; worth running migrations once to confirm.
